title: TASK-025 detached hash record
$comment: Canonical JSON: UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings, sorted object keys, two-space indentation, exactly one trailing LF. Timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 with Z and millisecond precision. This follows the approved detached-record contract: artifact_path, artifact_sha256, canonicalization_version, computed_at, and computed_by. A historical detached record need not invent a window_manifest_sha256 when no hash-bound manifest existed. Actual future live evidence remains bound to its required window manifest in the containing live record and artifact schema. computed_by is an IdentityRef when known or a typed UNAVAILABLE marker when intentionally unavailable; do not substitute free-form actor text. artifact_sha256 covers the complete target artifact bytes, including all fields; hash this record separately only when packaged in a package manifest.
